# AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record

```csharp
public sealed record AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer : ParticleRenderer
```

Types: [`ParticleRenderer`](ParticleRenderer.md)

Draws each particle as a frame of a [`SpriteAnimation`](SpriteAnimation.md), chosen from its age, so frames, holds and playback are authored like any sprite animation. Create one with [`ParticleRenderer.Animation`](ParticleRenderer.md#animation).

## Properties

### Pivot

```csharp
public Vector2 Pivot { get; init; }
```

Where each frame is placed, and what it scales and rotates around, from (0, 0) at its top left to (1, 1) at its bottom right.

### Size

```csharp
public Vector2? Size { get; init; }
```

The size a particle draws at before its scale; null for the animation's logical size.

```csharp

```

### Timing

```csharp
public ParticleAnimationTiming Timing { get; init; }
```

Types: [`ParticleAnimationTiming`](ParticleAnimationTiming.md)

How the animation is timed: once over each particle's life, or from its age.

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`ParticleDrawState`](ParticleDrawState.md)
